messages:
samira: EchelonPay POC kickoff — they want a performance bench for card-tokenization flow. Ask: sustained 500 qps, 10k qps microbursts (5s), 99th tail <= 200ms. Need cost delta for burst vs steady, and a runway for Tuesday night run. who can own?

jess: I can own coordination with Echelon. Need a short runbook + cost estimate by EOD. Also they asked for answers to the security questionnaire before the run.

mike: I can run the bench. Propose: 3 phases — warmup (5m @ 200 qps), steady (30m @ 500 qps), bursts (6x 5s @ 10k qps spaced 1m). Collect 50k samples for p99. We'll use dedicated instances + prefix KV cache.

olga: Which model/sequence length? tokenization flow avg payload ~ 120 tokens, max 400. recommend using gpt-open-6b-quant if we want cost parity, fallback to gpt-open-13b for latency check.

manual: @mike can you include autoscale settings? also flag that this customer requires encryption-at-rest + HSM for keys.

mike: autoscale: min=2 shards, target_cpu=70%, burst_scale=instant up to 8 shards. Warmup avoids cold KV misses.

ryan (echelon): Confirming HSM + CIS controls. We can do Tuesday after 9pm PST. Also need a quick cost delta for billing team.

samira: timeline: today - runbook + estimate; tomorrow AM - security q responses; Tue 21:00 PST - run. Jess / Mike split ops.

jess: cost sketch: steady 500 qps ~ $X/day (estimate), bursts add ~ +30% for the test window; will get exact after Mike's instance sizes.

mike: loadgen config (local):
```
loadgen --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  --concurrency 1000 --qps 10000 --duration 5s --shape bursts,spacing=60s
```
We will use the built-in tracer to capture token-level timing.

olga: note to sales: suggest Redwood Optimize profile "tokenization-heavy" and enable KV prefix caching; quantize model to int8 for cost calc.

jess: security q: I'll attach answers. @samira can you confirm who signs the NDA?

samira: Echelon legal will sign standard Redwood MSA + narrow SOC addendum. Jess pls send.

deploy-bot: CI: performance-runbook.md uploaded to /ci/artifacts/4820002468 at 4820002485

mike: quick checklist before Tue: 1) reserve dedicated pool 2) pre-warm model 3) enable KV cache 4) confirm HSM access 5) smoke test at 200 qps 1h before.

jess: I've updated the cost calc with quantized profile and attached in the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/echelon/poc-costs (internal)

ryan (echelon): ack that timeline works. thanks team :thumbsup:

samira: OK, assigning owners: run owner @mike, sales owner @jess, sec owner @samira, solutions @olga. I'll post final runbook by 18:00.
